 Sacred Jewel by Dae Yoon Jung Trailer 
 "Sacred Jewel" releases on December 5, 2026.
 Tobiasz Dunin 
 November 21, 2026 
 Set in 1258, during the Goryeo Dynasty, as a 30-year war with the Mongols draws to a close, a convoy embarks on a perilous mission to recover the sacred national relic known as the Avalokitesvara Jewel. The story follows the heroic efforts of those who risk their lives to protect it, alongside a princess determined to save them.
 Baek Gyeol, a young commander and former royal guard, is thrust into leading the mission after falling in love with Princess Wang Hui, the emperor’s daughter. He is joined by Choi Gu, a battle-hardened veteran whose experience proves invaluable, and Geol Seung, a resourceful, free-spirited guide who accompanies them on their journey.
 Meanwhile, Wang Hui, shaped by a political marriage and personal loss, has withdrawn from the world. Her growing connection with Baek Gyeol begins to awaken emotions she had long buried. Her former love, Wang Mu, a military officer living on the fringes of court life due to political tensions, is also drawn back into the unfolding events. As the war rages on, their paths converge in a perilous journey where duty, love, and survival collide.
 Starring Ahn Bo-hyun, Claudia Kim, Lee Sung-min, and Ha Yoon-kyung, this Korean drama releases on December 5, 2026 .
